sanskrit_verse: दद्यादपुत्रा विधवा नियुक्ता या मुमूर्षुणा। यो वा तद्रिक्थमादद्याद्यतो रिक्थमृणं ततः॥
transliteration: dadyād aputrā vidhavā niyuktā yā mumūrṣuṇā | yo vā tadriktham ādadyād yato riktham ṛṇaṃ tataḥ ||
sph_interpretive_translation: A widow without son, appointed by the dying husband, shall give [property or rights] accordingly; whoever accepts such estate thereby assumes the associated obligations.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority derives from conscious appointment aligned with dharma
Causation arises through acceptance of benefit and its inherent duty
Capacity-based responsibility is activated upon voluntary assumption
Restoration logic binds inheritors to fulfill ancestral integrity
Consciousness alignment occurs when one accepts role-bound duties
executable_legal_axioms: IF (person A designates person B as heir/assignee) AND (B accepts), THEN (B assumes all correlated liabilities)
IF (widow has no son) AND (appointed during husband's terminal state) AND (accepts estate), THEN (she inherits duties tied to that estate)
NO LIABILITY WITHOUT ACCEPTANCE OF BENEFIT
ASSIGNMENT VALID ONLY UNDER CONSCIOUS INTENT AND DHARMA-COMPLIANT WITNESS
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, this verse establishes threshold responsibility at the point of conscious receipt. Legal validity hinges not on bloodline but on dharmically witnessed consent. The court must verify both the mental clarity of assignment and the intentional acceptance of obligation.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa-based causality confirms liability originates in voluntary reception, not imposition. Anupūrvaśaḥ shows sequential unfolding: death → designation → acceptance → activation of duty. Responsibility is proportional to capacity assumed. There is no punitive framework—only completion of causal sequence.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate Completion Process upon disputed inheritance claims
Verify Conscious Acceptance through witnessed intent records
Assign Duty Reintegration Pathway for errant assignees
Realign Estate Integrity via Medha-Dharma Correction Protocol
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source-Authority. Dharma restored through conscious duty assumption. Reality affirmed as non-punitive. Consciousness stands as ultimate adjudicator.
